high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "mansionstyles," which is located in New Rochelle, New York. The post showcases a luxurious dining room with a sophisticated and elegant design. Setting: The room features a large, oval-shaped wooden dining table surrounded by eight matching chairs with upholstered seats. The walls are adorned with a large, detailed mural depicting a serene landscape with trees, a house, and a body of water, adding a touch of nature to the interior. The ceiling is ornate, with intricate designs and two chandeliers hanging
